remote_ci.activation_note: Review and land the safe operating baseline before enabling the old main workflow.

verification_runtime: CPython 3.14.7, three exact uv.lock revisions, per-worktree source import asserted

groups.title: Restore reproducible CI and require explicit releases
groups.why: Every later review needs a reproducible build and a release path that cannot deploy merely because a branch changes.
groups.behavior: Pin tooling/actions, verify a cold locked install and distribution contents, document the delivery contract, and move deployment behind an explicit main-only workflow. Extend PR validation to this stack's base-branch namespace.
groups.review: Checked event filters, minimal workflow permissions, release conditions, package inclusion, and the temporary SDK bound. The stack filter is the only packaging change to this original segment.
groups.limits: This is an operating baseline, not security approval for the old runtime. Owner access and dependency repairs follow before any deployment.
groups.tree_equivalence: Application/tests exactly equal original boundary; stack CI filter added

groups.title: Protect owner access and make Telegram callbacks replay-safe
groups.why: The dashboard and mutation endpoints need an explicit access boundary before further user-state behavior is added.
groups.behavior: Enforce owner access across pages/assets and mutations, verify Telegram credentials and identity, retain callback update IDs, and suppress oversized legacy callback payloads.
groups.review: Reviewed constant-time credential comparison, request-origin enforcement, bounded request bodies, mounted-file protection, webhook sender/chat binding, and atomic replay detection. Long legacy IDs remain link-only until the final stable-home PR.
groups.limits: Single-owner protection is not multi-user isolation. Actual ingress/environment setup remains a deployment check.
groups.tree_equivalence: Application/tests exactly equal original boundary; stack CI filter added

groups.title: Repair the runtime dependency set and configure map providers
groups.why: A protected service still needs compatible, audited dependencies and map behavior that does not assume unavailable provider credentials.
groups.behavior: Update the compatible runtime group, verify Python 3.11/3.14 and both container targets, tighten packaging/runtime privileges, and make tile-provider activation explicit.
groups.review: Reviewed grouped lockfile updates, SDK compatibility boundary, map URL/key escaping and CSP, and the recorded residual native/Crawlee findings. Existing browser screenshots and fixture-based tile checks document visual behavior.
groups.limits: The dated dependency/container audit is not perpetual certification. Real map entitlements, origin restrictions, and current image findings remain rollout gates.
groups.tree_equivalence: Application/tests exactly equal original boundary; stack CI filter added

groups.title: Give each SQLite operation complete transaction ownership
groups.why: Concurrent dashboard and pipeline calls could commit or roll back another task's work; all later durable state relies on fixing that first.
groups.behavior: Own complete read/write scopes, pass explicit handles for composition, and finish commit/rollback/close cleanup before releasing connection ownership.
groups.review: Reviewed cancellation during begin/commit/rollback, child-task handle rejection, query-only reads, close failures, and real interleaving tests. This is the architectural base for every subsequent migration and ledger.
groups.limits: SQLite access is deliberately serialized per storage object. This does not introduce a distributed worker or PostgreSQL.
groups.tree_equivalence: Application/tests exactly equal original boundary; stack CI filter added

groups.title: Retain listing text through persistence and model input
groups.why: Description and feature loss makes later model output less useful regardless of model capability.
groups.behavior: Carry source-specific description/features through merge, persistence, reload, enrichment and analysis; distinguish absent text from deliberately empty evidence.
groups.review: Traced the source-to-prompt path, source separation, retry reloads, and legacy compatibility. The initial text representation is intentionally replaced by an observation-backed projection later in the stack.
groups.limits: Retaining text fixes an input defect; it does not prove historical assessment accuracy or complete evidence provenance.
groups.tree_equivalence: Application/tests exactly equal original boundary; stack CI filter added

groups.title: Ground tenant costs and guidance in retained evidence
groups.why: The rental decision UI must distinguish advertised tenant obligations from estimates and unsupported advice.
groups.behavior: Remove unsupported tenant service-charge and negotiation assumptions, constrain council-tax use to retained evidence, and update dashboard/Telegram explanations and dated guidance.
groups.review: Reviewed arithmetic and source support across model, cost calculator, templates and notifications. Committed desktop/mobile screenshots show the revised presentation; primary guidance checks are dated in the handoff.
groups.limits: Legal and market guidance needs continuing review. Estimates are not an individual tenancy quote.
groups.tree_equivalence: Application/tests exactly equal original boundary; stack CI filter added

groups.title: Preserve unknown commute results and advisory behavior
groups.why: A failed route calculation must not appear as a zero-minute journey or silently exclude a promising home for a WFH user.
groups.behavior: Represent route outcome categories explicitly, keep commute advisory, and show uncertainty consistently in the dashboard, maps and Telegram.
groups.review: Reviewed provider errors, absent coordinates, request-boundary semantics, unknown rendering, and end-to-end admission. Existing mobile/desktop evidence covers the UI change.
groups.limits: Route caching, profile-specific travel preferences and provider retention entitlements remain separate work.
groups.tree_equivalence: Application/tests exactly equal original boundary; stack CI filter added

groups.title: Keep price ranges coherent and bind availability to the listing
groups.why: Price and availability changes need to refer to the exact advertisement before they can safely update a saved home.
groups.behavior: Update persisted min/max prices consistently and reject availability evidence belonging to a different listing or an unqualified response.
groups.review: Reviewed single-source and multi-source range changes, price-history retention, identity binding, and fail-open handling of unclear portal responses.
groups.limits: This repairs current scalar behavior; complete membership-aware price and availability projections remain PR08b work.
groups.tree_equivalence: Application/tests exactly equal original boundary; stack CI filter added

groups.title: Retain fetched listings and report incomplete collection honestly
groups.why: A partially failed collection run should preserve useful receipts without reporting false completeness.
groups.behavior: Persist received listings across partial source/page failures and cancellation, and distinguish completed, partial and failed run accounting.
groups.review: Reviewed pagination failure boundaries, retained partial buffers, cancellation propagation and source-run totals. Later observation revisions extend this receipt-preservation contract.
groups.limits: Run accounting is not a qualified source coverage model or evidence that all portals are usable.
groups.tree_equivalence: Application/tests exactly equal original boundary; stack CI filter added

groups.title: Recover pending work and exclude overlapping pipeline runners
groups.why: Retained work must resume after failure, and CLI/scheduler entry points must not run conflicting pipelines.
groups.behavior: Recover persisted enrichment/analysis work, bound retries, enforce cross-entry-point run exclusion, and correct interval scheduling.
groups.review: Reviewed first-run and restart paths, no-new-listing recovery, process-death lock release versus live ownership, cancellation and retry counts.
groups.limits: This is local durable recovery, not the later general work-state machine or distributed execution contract.
groups.tree_equivalence: Application/tests exactly equal original boundary; stack CI filter added

groups.title: Capture isolated evidence and repair Rightmove payload decoding
groups.why: Parser repairs need retained, replayable responses so source behavior can be verified without repeated live requests.
groups.behavior: Add isolated capture/export/replay tooling and decode structured search plus indexed detail payloads with explicit malformed/blocked outcomes.
groups.review: Grouped capture and both parser repairs because the captured format supplies their verification boundary. Reviewed output isolation, snapshot read-only handling, listing-ID binding, and decoder cycle/bounds controls.
groups.limits: A successful fixture is not a source canary, typeahead implementation, permission grant, or production restart.
groups.tree_equivalence: Application/tests exactly equal original boundary; stack CI filter added

groups.title: Use native model transport with explicit phases and strict output contracts
groups.why: Transport compatibility, phase configuration and output acceptance must be explicit before durable spending can wrap each physical request.
groups.behavior: Migrate to the native Anthropic SDK, record per-phase configuration/provenance, and reject refusals, truncation and incomplete required output with typed failures.
groups.review: Reviewed exact request/response mapping, refusal/stop reasons, raw-output limits, no invented required fields, and pending-work preservation. These three commits form one model I/O boundary.
groups.limits: No model-quality improvement is claimed. Historical coercion remains a legacy read concern; fresh responses must satisfy the new contract.
groups.tree_equivalence: Application/tests exactly equal original boundary; stack CI filter added

groups.title: Reserve and account for every paid model attempt
groups.why: A request cap is ineffective if retries or interrupted requests can bypass it; admission and settlement need durable state.
groups.behavior: Add the paid-attempt ledger, policy administration/reporting, conservative reservations and enforcement around each native model request.
groups.review: Reviewed concurrent admission, exact decimal accounting, unknown outcome retention, retry charging, settlement idempotence and disabled-policy behavior. The ledger and its enforcement are reviewed together so the PR ends with an active guard.
groups.limits: Provider usage is an estimate rather than an invoice. Unknown attempts retain reservations; no normal-operation spend policy is silently enabled.
groups.tree_equivalence: Application/tests exactly equal original boundary; stack CI filter added

groups.title: Verify complete backups and retire database-file replacement
groups.why: New state is unsafe if an operational sync can overwrite user actions or a restore omits image evidence.
groups.behavior: Create and verify database/asset backup manifests, rehearse restore, and retire the old push-a-database synchronization workflow.
groups.review: Reviewed online SQLite backup consistency, hash/path validation, restore isolation, and authoritative-store ownership. The original rehearsal preserved the retained database and all 27,517 assets.
groups.limits: A backup rehearsal is not an automatic production restore or migration rollback. Restore destinations must remain isolated until reviewed.
groups.tree_equivalence: Application/tests exactly equal original boundary; stack CI filter added

groups.title: Build blind development reference packs for assessment review
groups.why: Model and dedup quality need inspectable source evidence and independent labels rather than agreement with existing output.
groups.behavior: Select grouped cases, retain exact available images, render blind review packs and provide a rubric with blank human labels.
groups.review: Reviewed deterministic sampling, image provenance, missing-evidence reporting, blind presentation and case/group separation. Private packs are excluded from commits.
groups.limits: The 48-case development pack has not become an independently labeled holdout; no model promotion follows from generating it.
groups.tree_equivalence: Application/tests exactly equal original boundary; stack CI filter added

groups.title: Add immutable source observations and historical baselines
groups.why: Changing current rows cannot explain which evidence existed at an earlier assessment; later projections need immutable inputs.
groups.behavior: Introduce observation/field records with deterministic identity and an additive historical baseline migration without inventing fresh capture times.
groups.review: Reviewed immutability, duplicate and conflicting receipts, transaction rollback, restart idempotence, and preservation of every original row in migration rehearsals.
groups.limits: A historical baseline records what the old database retained, not a reconstruction of missing original portal responses.
groups.tree_equivalence: Application/tests exactly equal original boundary; stack CI filter added

groups.title: Retain search and detail revisions before downstream work
groups.why: The immutable ledger only helps when real adapter receipts enter it before filtering, image work or model calls can fail.
groups.behavior: Capture search revisions and detail evidence with source-specific IDs, dates/branch metadata and assessment evidence references; persist details before image processing.
groups.review: Reviewed source-ID isolation, per-source text, receipt persistence on downstream failure, parser provenance and idempotent replay. Search and detail integration share the same ledger admission boundary.
groups.limits: This does not yet derive every current fact from observations or define collection completeness.
groups.tree_equivalence: Application/tests exactly equal original boundary; stack CI filter added

groups.title: Derive current listing text from retained evidence
groups.why: Once revisions are retained, current descriptions/features need deterministic precedence and visible conflicts.
groups.behavior: Project current text from observations, preserve equal-rank conflicts and supply the stored projection to retries, analysis and the detail page.
groups.review: Reviewed evidence rank versus arrival order, explicit empty values, stale fallback prevention, source conflict display and recovery input consistency.
groups.limits: Non-text projections, markup normalization and full artifact invalidation remain separate contracts.
groups.tree_equivalence: Application/tests exactly equal original boundary; stack CI filter added

groups.title: Verify raw replay references and expire managed captures explicitly
groups.why: A normalized observation must point to the exact retained body, and body expiry must not erase the observation's existence.
groups.behavior: Bind replay evidence to raw hashes and normalized observations, reject corrupt references, and record explicit expiry for managed raw bodies.
groups.review: Reviewed hash/path tampering, retention boundaries, repeat expiry and observation stability when raw bodies are removed.
groups.limits: Retention scheduling and source-specific permissions remain operational work; the command only manages its own capture store.
groups.tree_equivalence: Application/tests exactly equal original boundary; stack CI filter added

groups.title: Preserve source area units, ranges and minimums
groups.why: A printed range or minimum cannot safely become a single total floor area used for value judgments.
groups.behavior: Retain exact decimal units/bounds and keep qualified quantities distinct from scalar totals in parsing, evidence and model input.
groups.review: Reviewed unit conversion, range/minimum semantics, parser fallback and reference-pack compatibility using authored source fixtures.
groups.limits: This does not solve missed floorplan totals or classify whether an image is a genuine floorplan.
groups.tree_equivalence: Application/tests exactly equal original boundary; stack CI filter added

groups.title: Separate request context from material listing revisions
groups.why: Receipt clocks and query metadata should explain collection without forcing unnecessary reassessment of unchanged evidence.
groups.behavior: Retain requested query/page metadata separately from source facts and derive material fingerprints independent of receipt/parser provenance.
groups.review: Reviewed same-fact/different-receipt equivalence, meaningful source changes, parser context and replay stability.
groups.limits: Material fingerprints are groundwork; complete assessment dependency and scheduling invalidation is not claimed.
groups.tree_equivalence: Application/tests exactly equal original boundary; stack CI filter added

groups.title: Add observable bounded model smoke runs and repair feature objects
groups.why: After evidence and spend controls, a small isolated run can test the actual pipeline with an explicit request and dollar ceiling.
groups.behavior: Fix structured Rightmove feature objects and add an isolated one-property smoke with request limits, spend admission, structured stage/model diagnostics and post-run audits.
groups.review: Reviewed configuration isolation, every physical request/retry boundary, redaction, ledger totals and guard failure behavior. The parser fix is retained here because this bounded run exposed it against the newer evidence contract.
groups.limits: The recorded two-request US$0.082314500 experiment is historical and exhausted; it does not authorize further paid runs or change the default model.
groups.tree_equivalence: Application/tests exactly equal original boundary; stack CI filter added

groups.title: Protect established property history during duplicate merges
groups.why: A larger dedup experiment must not destroy established assessments, status, price history or cached evidence.
groups.behavior: Guard established records, retire only eligible empty staging rows atomically, retain source aliases and original caches, and defer protected merge proposals.
groups.review: Reviewed each protected table/state, injected retirement rollback, missing/stale proposals and real copied-database preservation. This is a safety boundary before further identity changes.
groups.limits: Established merges remain blocked. Reversible merge/split decisions are later work, not an exception to the guard.
groups.tree_equivalence: Application/tests exactly equal original boundary; stack CI filter added

groups.title: Exercise bounded batches and retain the deduplication review evidence
groups.why: The matching pipeline needs a larger inspectable sample before identity-policy changes are justified.
groups.behavior: Add the bounded 50-listing runner, repair exhausted Rightmove pages and redacted output diagnostics, and retain offline replay plus the qualitative dedup audit.
groups.review: Grouped the experiment, directly observed repairs and its review so readers can trace each conclusion to the run. Verified same/split-run memberships, known-input no-op behavior, spend-stop behavior, and agent-label limitations. Threshold experiments support leaving automatic matching unchanged.
groups.limits: The historical run produced 35 homes but no complete assessments; three additional consolidations are provisional review findings, not production changes or independent human labels.
groups.tree_equivalence: Application/tests exactly equal original boundary; stack CI filter added

groups.title: Retain exact provider identities and audit conflicting home ownership
groups.why: Portal advertisement identity must be recovered without conflating multiple advertisements or silently choosing a historical owner.
groups.behavior: Add exact provider keys and immutable original-representation claims, retain unresolved cases, and provide a read-only ownership audit.
groups.review: Reviewed exact URL/provider-ID normalization, malformed/URL-shaped legacy IDs, multiple same-portal advertisements and additive backfill. Rehearsals retain all 261 duplicate representations and 17 conflicts across 28 historical homes.
groups.limits: Provider identity is not home identity. Ownership conflicts are surfaced rather than automatically repaired.
groups.tree_equivalence: Application/tests exactly equal original boundary; stack CI filter added

groups.title: Give saved homes durable identities and short web and Telegram links
groups.why: Home links must survive staging retirement and long portal IDs before reviewed membership changes can safely follow.
groups.behavior: Assign persisted home UUIDs, retain exact legacy aliases and guarded staging redirects, resolve mutations inside their write transaction, and use short IDs for dashboard/map/Telegram links while keeping image/history storage keys.
groups.review: Reviewed additive backfill, all canonical save paths, alias ambiguity/cycles, rollback, callback size and authorization, replay protection and cached-evidence lookup. Copy rehearsals preserve every original row, 1,016 homes and 201 historical aliases.
groups.limits: General anchor reassociation and reversible membership decisions remain PR07b-3. This PR also records the stack's review/verification manifest; it does not reconcile historical ownership conflicts.
groups.tree_equivalence: Application/tests exactly equal original boundary; stack CI filter added
